C0000.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must inform the entity of the deficiency to be corrected.
C0000.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0001.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must require the entity to correct the deficiency.
C0001.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0002.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must either offer training and technical assistance, if appropriate, to help correct the deficiency, and prepare and submit to the Secretary a report describing the training and technical assistance offered; or, if the State determines that such training and technical assistance are not appropriate, prepare and submit to the Secretary a report stating the reasons for the determination.
C0002.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0003.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must, at its discretion (taking into account the seriousness of the deficiency and the time reasonably required to correct the deficiency), allow the entity to develop and implement, within 60 days after being informed of the deficiency, a quality improvement plan to correct such deficiency within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the State.
C0003.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0004.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must, not later than 30 days after receiving from an eligible entity a proposed quality improvement plan pursuant to subparagraph (A), either approve such proposed plan or specify the reasons why the proposed plan cannot be approved.
C0004.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0005.summary: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must, after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, initiate proceedings to terminate the designation of or reduce the funding under this chapter of the eligible entity unless the entity corrects the deficiency.
C0005.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

C0006.summary: A determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary.

C0007.summary: The Secretary must, upon request, review a determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity, and the review must be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination.

C0008.summary: If the Secretary's review is not completed within 90 days after receiving from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding, the determination of the State shall become final at the end of the 90th day.
C0008.scope_text: If the review is not completed within 90 days

C0009.summary: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b), the Secretary is authorized to provide financial assistance under this chapter to the eligible entity affected until the violation is corrected.
C0009.scope_text: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b)

C0010.summary: When a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces funding prior to the completion of the State hearing and the Secretary's review, and the Secretary provides financial assistance to the affected eligible entity, the grant or allotment for the State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the earliest appropriate fiscal year must be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under subsection (c) to such eligible entity.

inventory.U0000: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review under section 9914, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement or the State plan to provide services under this chapter, or fails to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must inform the entity of the deficiency to be corrected.
inventory.U0001: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review under section 9914, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement or the State plan to provide services under this chapter, or fails to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State must require the entity to correct the deficiency.
inventory.U0002: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State must, as one alternative, offer training and technical assistance if appropriate to help correct the deficiency, and prepare and submit to the Secretary a report describing the training and technical assistance offered.
inventory.U0003: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State must, as an alternative if it determines that training and technical assistance are not appropriate, prepare and submit to the Secretary a report stating the reasons for that determination.
inventory.U0004: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State is authorized, at its discretion (taking into account the seriousness of the deficiency and the time reasonably required to correct it), to allow the entity to develop and implement, within 60 days after being informed of the deficiency, a quality improvement plan to correct the deficiency within a reasonable period of time as determined by the State.
inventory.U0005: Not later than 30 days after receiving a proposed quality improvement plan from an eligible entity pursuant to subparagraph (A), the State must either approve the proposed plan or specify the reasons why it cannot be approved.
inventory.U0006: If the State determines under subsection (a) that an eligible entity has a deficiency, the State must, after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, initiate proceedings to terminate the designation of or reduce the funding under this chapter of the eligible entity unless the entity corrects the deficiency.
inventory.U0007: A State determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary, and the Secretary must review such a determination upon request.
inventory.U0008: The Secretary's review of a determination to terminate designation or reduce funding must be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination.
inventory.U0009: If the Secretary's review is not completed within 90 days after receiving all necessary documentation from the State, the determination of the State becomes final at the end of the 90th day.
inventory.U0010: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b), the Secretary is authorized to provide financial assistance under this chapter to the affected eligible entity until the violation is corrected.
inventory.U0011: Whenever the Secretary provides direct assistance under subsection (c) because a State prematurely terminated or reduced funding in violation of section 9908(b)(8) assurances, the State's grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 for the earliest appropriate fiscal year must be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under subsection (c) to the eligible entity.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures paragraph (a)(1), requiring the State to inform an eligible entity of the deficiency to be corrected if the State determines non-compliance based on a final review decision under section 9914.
Claim C0001 accurately conveys paragraph (a)(2), requiring the State to mandate that the eligible entity correct the deficiency upon determining non-compliance under subsection (a).

Claim C0002 fully and correctly states the disjunctive requirement of paragraph (a)(3), covering offering training and technical assistance with a report to the Secretary, or reporting reasons why such assistance is not appropriate.
Claim C0003 accurately states paragraph (a)(4)(A), including the State's discretion to allow a quality improvement plan within 60 days to correct the deficiency within a reasonable timeframe.

Claim C0004 precisely captures paragraph (a)(4)(B), requiring the State within 30 days of receipt of a proposed quality improvement plan to either approve it or specify reasons why it cannot be approved.

Claim C0005 accurately conveys paragraph (a)(5), requiring the State to provide notice and hearing opportunity and initiate termination or reduction proceedings unless the entity corrects the deficiency.
Claim C0006 accurately states the statutory rule of subsection (b) that a determination to terminate designation or reduce funding is reviewable by the Secretary.

Claim C0007 properly reflects subsection (b)'s requirement that the Secretary review such determinations upon request and complete the review within 90 days after receiving all necessary documentation from the State.

Claim C0008 faithfully states the statutory consequence under subsection (b) that the State's determination becomes final at the end of the 90th day if the Secretary's review is not completed within that timeframe.
Claim C0010 accurately conveys subsection (c)'s mandatory reduction of the State's grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 by an amount equal to direct assistance provided by the Secretary.

Claim C0009 captures subsection (c)'s authorization for the Secretary to provide direct financial assistance until the violation is corrected if a State terminates or reduces funding prior to the completion of hearing and review.
